issue.title: Bug: test_cpu_shaper.py failed with AssertionError: CPU queue shaper missing for cos queues {0, 7} before reboot. Got: {}

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Test fails as cos queue information is missing at the time of assertion.  On full-scale topologies the test is flaky as the assertion fires before all cos queues are ready.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test cpu_shaper/test_cpu_shaper.py on full-scale topology testbed.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test should assert on converged state once all cos queues are ready.

resolution.title: Make sure lldp is populated after dut/service restart
resolution.description:
Timing on full-topos is such that straight assertions in cpu_shaper
tests can be flaky. Use wait_until when fetching and verifying cpu
queue shapers before and after DUT reboot to get test passrate to
reflect eventual state.

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #25176

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [x] 202511
- [ ] 202512
- [x] 202605

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Improve passrate on topologies in 202511 and 202605 by improving test to be less reliant on straight assertions which have timing isses.

#### How did you do it?
Use wait_until to assert on eventual state.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verifed test is no longer flaky on multiple topologies.

#### Any platform specific information?
None.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
N/A
